About EG Eloma

Big-company technology, from one team that knows you by name

EG Eloma is an Australian-owned technology company in Melbourne, by Eloma Group. We build custom software and run digital marketing for businesses worldwide.

Book a free consultation →Call 1800 054 555 (AU)WhatsApp

Our story

Five suppliers. None of them talking to each other.

We started EG Eloma after seeing small and mid-sized businesses juggle a web designer, an IT provider, a phone company, a marketing agency and a Microsoft reseller, none of whom talked to each other.

Then came the subscriptions: a monthly fee for every app, per user, each with its own settings and its own copy of your data. So we started building the alternative: one system the business owns, and one team that looks after it.

Mission

Give every organisation, whatever its size, the technology, security and marketing of a large company, delivered by one team that knows them by name.

Vision

Technology that quietly runs smoothly, so people can focus on their customers and communities.

Promise

Plain English, written quotes and honest advice, even when the answer is "you don't need that".

What we do

Own your software. Grow your customers.

Our focus is two things that make the biggest difference to a growing business. First, custom software that replaces the stack of monthly subscriptions most businesses rent, with one system they own, can scale and any developer can maintain. Second, digital marketing that brings in real enquiries, measured and reported in plain English.

Around that, we offer the Microsoft, communications, cloud and security services businesses rely on every day, so one team can look after the whole picture. We work from Melbourne with English-speaking businesses anywhere in the world, quoting in AUD or USD.

Our approach to security

  • Multi-factor authentication on every managed system
  • Least-privilege access
  • Encryption in transit and at rest
  • Daily backups with tested restores
  • Essential Eight aligned practices
  • NDAs available on request

How we work with clients

From first conversation to ongoing partnership

Every engagement starts with listening, then a fixed written quote before any work begins.

  1. Discovery

    We map how your business runs today and every subscription you pay for.

  2. Fixed written quote

    Scope, timeline and price in plain English, in AUD or USD.

  3. Build in stages

    You see working software early and give feedback as we go.

  4. Handover & training

    Source code, documentation and training for your team.
